suggestions: I'm grateful for the serene quiet right before Fajr, giving me time to breathe and start the day with a centered mind.
I'm thankful for the immense relief of finally resolving a tricky bug that has been haunting our staging environment all week.
I'm grateful for a warm cup of teh tarik and fresh roti canai during a quick morning break at the mamak.
I'm thankful for a clean pull request review with no major blockers, keeping our sprint on schedule.
I'm grateful for the soothing sound of afternoon rain tapping against the window while I'm in deep focus mode.
I'm thankful for the rezeki of a stable career that allows me to support myself and share with my family.
I'm grateful for a seamless Friday production deployment that went live without setting off any weekend on-call alerts.
I'm thankful for teammates who are always willing to hop on a quick huddle to pair program when things get stuck.
I'm grateful for having a quiet, peaceful surau nearby where I can step away from the monitors and recenter my intentions.
I'm thankful for catching an uncrowded MRT ride home after a long, productive day at the office.
I'm grateful for a comforting home-cooked meal and quality time with my parents over the weekend.
I'm thankful for that satisfying moment when the entire automated test suite passes green on the first try.
I'm grateful for the flexibility of working from home on days when I need uninterrupted focus to build new features.
I'm thankful for the blessing of good health, energy, and curiosity to keep leveling up my technical skills.
I'm grateful for an evening stroll through the pasar malam, unplugging from screens to enjoy good local street food.
